brief: A right hook that lands on the side of the target's head at 0.8 s, the elbow bent at least 70 deg at impact, feet planted.
notes: Fighter 2 is a still target facing the hero. 30 fps. A hook is a bent arm swung across, not a straight punch.

asserts.line: right fist touches fighter 2 head at 0.8 s +-2 f
right elbow above 70 deg bend at 0.8 s +-2 f
